description: This file defines a Java interface for hook-related write operations in the Fineract infrastructure, including methods for creating, updating, and deleting hooks.

classes.name: HookWritePlatformService
classes.description: Interface defining methods for managing hooks: creating, updating, and deleting.

methods.name: createHook
methods.description: Creates a new hook based on the provided JsonCommand.

methods.name: updateHook
methods.description: Updates an existing hook identified by hookId with data from the JsonCommand.

methods.name: deleteHook
methods.description: Deletes the hook specified by hookId.
